subfiles.title: List of Papers: Military Affairs in Formosa (894a.20)
subfiles.about: A two-page index summarizes papers concerning Japanese military organization, defenses, security restrictions, and wartime activity in Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: Indexes Matsui's command arrival, a map-sale espionage incident and arrest, spy fears, navigation/photography restrictions, a consulate intrusion by a light-control guard, Kaohsiung's fortified zone, Furushō succeeding Hata, Taiwan's war footing, and China-bound air raids.

interest: Shows Taiwan's progression from routine defense reporting to espionage fears and wartime mobilization.
